d: We are seeking a highly motivated Analyst/Associate to join our Structured Finance team. The ideal candidate will support the structuring, execution, and monitoring of complex financial transactions across emerging and frontier markets.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or related field.
1–4 years of relevant experience in investment banking, structured finance, project finance, or private credit.
Advanced financial modeling and Excel skills; proficiency in PowerPoint and Word.
Previous exposure to private credit, trade finance, or real assets preferred.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Fluency in French is mandatory. Understanding of Portuguese is a plus.
Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
r: Assist in structuring bespoke financing solutions including securitizations, project finance, and asset-backed lending transactions. Prepare term sheets, credit memos, and deal documentation in coordination with legal advisors.
Develop and maintain robust financial models to assess transaction feasibility, returns, risk sensitivities, and stress scenarios.
Support end-to-end due diligence processes by liaising with legal, technical, tax, and financial advisors. Prepare data rooms and manage information flow with counterparties.
Conduct market analysis to identify trends, risks, and investment opportunities. Maintain sector databases and contribute to origination efforts through research and pitch materials.’
Assist in pipeline tracking, client presentations, and investment committee materials. Support senior team members in relationship management and business development.
Support transactions in high-growth markets by understanding local macroeconomic conditions, regulatory environments, and risk frameworks.
Coordinate with internal risk, compliance, and legal teams during deal review processes and ensure timely response to queries and documentation needs.
Support post-closing monitoring activities, including data collection, covenant tracking, and reporting on portfolio performance metrics.
Assist in developing pitch decks, teasers, and transaction snapshots for potential co-lenders, investors, or syndication partners.
